mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_meeting_v2_record (meeting_id, kind, member_id, payload, run_epoch) VALUES (#{meetingId}, #{kind}, #{memberId}, #{payload}, #{runEpoch})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_meeting_v2_record WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND kind = #{kind} AND member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT * FROM ai_meeting_v2_record WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY id
SELECT CONCAT(COUNT(*), '-', COALESCE(MAX(id), 0), '-', COALESCE(SUM(LENGTH(payload)), 0)) FROM ai_meeting_v2_record WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_meeting_v2_record SET payload = #{payload} WHERE id = #{id}
